sleep.title: Riyadh Airport Marriott
sleep.text: Riyadh Airport Marriott Hotel is on Airport Road near King Khalid International Airport. The hotel has restaurants, an outdoor pool, a fitness centre and laundry facilities; on-site parking is free. Check-in starts at 15:00 with a minimum check-in age of 18; check-out is by 12:00. Phone: +966 11 8356300. According to the hotel’s own FAQ, no airport shuttle is provided.
